timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I will guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you will hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let us begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I feel like I should have everything figured out.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I keep comparing my life to an invisible timeline.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: Other people's certainty makes me question myself.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I am worried that I am falling behind.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body is carrying constant pressure to decide.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I feel like I should know exactly where I am going.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Part of me believes uncertainty means I am failing.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that I feel lost sometimes.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I am trying to solve my whole life at once.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that is completely okay. Keep breathing, and we will continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can release the demand for a complete plan.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: Many lives unfold through uncertainty.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: Someone else's timeline does not define mine.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can know the next step without knowing the destination.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can soften around unanswered questions.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I am allowed to change as I learn more about myself.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Uncertainty can be part of growth, not proof of failure.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can notice what feels true in this season.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can let today be enough for today.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You do not need the feeling to disappear. See if there is simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I trust my life to unfold one step at a time.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I can choose based on who I am now.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I carry wisdom even without every answer.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can build direction through lived experience.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can feel grounded in the present.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I do not need to perform certainty for anyone.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I am allowed to move at my own pace.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I trust myself to recognize the next right step.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I am here, and my life is already happening.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
